reply.text:
I can't give you a dose for ashwagandha, or any supplement. The amount depends on you, and I'm not the one to set it. Some small studies have looked at it for stress and for testosterone, but the evidence is limited and the products vary a lot in quality and strength. If you're considering it, a doctor or registered dietitian can tell you whether it makes sense for you and what amount is right, especially if you take any medication.

What I can do is look at the things that move testosterone and results the most: sleep, eating enough, and consistent heavy training. Want me to look at how your week is going on those?
